criteria: At least 2 distinct interactive behaviors are implemented using vanilla JavaScript — no libraries or frameworks
One of the interactions responds to a custom keyboard shortcut using keydown or keyup events (not just the default Enter/click behavior)
Event listeners are attached using addEventListener — no inline event handlers (onclick='...') in the HTML
DOM manipulation is performed correctly: elements are selected with querySelector or similar, and their content or style is changed dynamically
Client-side form validation is present: the form does not submit if required fields are empty or invalid, and the user sees a visible error message
